component.name: Jamelade
component.summary: Native Apple Music client for the Linux desktop

description.p: Jamelade presents Apple Music as a native GTK application while keeping the web engine hidden and restricted to MusicKit playback and sign-in.

ul.li: songs, albums, artists, playlists and catalogue search
personal recommendations, radio stations, listening history and storefront charts
optional lyrics with separate privacy opt-ins for each third-party source
three local Jamkin companions with matching accessible colour themes and optional playback animation
a resizable movable Desktop Jamkin with uncluttered synchronized lyrics on hover
selectable Jamkin launcher tiles confirmed and installed by the desktop portal
MPRIS controls for Plasma, GNOME and other Linux desktops

description.p: An active Apple Music subscription and an internet connection are required.
Jamelade is an unofficial community fork of Slipmat and is not affiliated with Apple Inc.

Jamelade 3.0 adds a useful Search landing page with private local history, playback-speed control, more reliable playlist additions with duplicate confirmation, stronger session restoration, richer theme polish, and refreshed Jamkin previews.
Jamelade 2.1 refines fully transparent album-art presentation with softer adaptive text contrast and clean selected-theme sidebar typography.

Jamelade 2.0 adds native playlist creation and additions, artist biographies and credits, selectable colour themes, localized synchronized lyrics, sleep and A–B timers, optional ListenBrainz scrobbling, global shortcuts, and a refined player.
First complete Jamelade release with native Apple Music Home, synchronized lyrics, responsive album-aware glass, artist pages, and selectable Jamkin companions.
